full_text_en:
Guilin Tongde Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Chongqing Jinshan Hotel Co., Ltd. et al. — Enforcement of Operational Rights

Applicant for Enforcement: Guilin Tongde Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

Legal Representative: Jiang Jianhua, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Party Subject to Enforcement: Chongqing Jinshan Hotel Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Wang Chengshu, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Party Subject to Enforcement: Chongqing Jinshan Property Development Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Wang Chengshu, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Party Subject to Enforcement: Chongqing Jinshan (Group) Development Co., Ltd.

Legal Representative: Wang Chengshu, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Party Subject to Enforcement: Wang Chengshu, male, born on January 5, 1937, residing at No. 4-4, No. 37 Jianshe Road, Chongqing.

On March 15, 1997, the applicant for enforcement, Guilin Tongde Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tongde Company), and the party subject to enforcement, Chongqing Jinshan Hotel Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hotel Company), entered into a loan agreement stipulating: Tongde Company would lend RMB 50 million to Hotel Company for the fine decoration, purchase of equipment and installation, and opening expenses of Jinshan Hotel; Hotel Company would pledge as security the property rights of Jinshan Hotel valued at RMB 80 million and the right to operate the hotel for five years; if Hotel Company failed to repay the loan on time, Tongde Company would have the right to first take the property rights of Jinshan Hotel valued at RMB 80 million and the five-year operational rights. The loan was to be repaid in the amount of RMB 35 million by September 30, 1997, and the remaining RMB 15 million by December 30, 1997. The loan was to be remitted by Hotel Company to the bank account of the party subject to enforcement, Chongqing Jinshan Property Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Property Company). On the same day the loan agreement was signed, the party subject to enforcement, Wang Chengshu, issued a "Letter of Commitment to Repay" to Tongde Company in his personal name, stating: "I personally guarantee to repay the debt of RMB 50 million and will continue to do so until it is fully repaid." On May 4 of the same year, Tongde Company entered into another "Loan Agreement" with the party subject to enforcement, Chongqing Jinshan (Group) Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Group Company), with the same loan amount, repayment date, and security terms. On May 8 of the same year, Hotel Company and Property Company jointly issued a "Letter of Commitment to Mortgage" to Tongde Company, stating: "Our company has existing property rights of RMB 0.8 billion in Chongqing Jinshan Hotel, which we agree to mortgage to your company as security for the loan, and will not mortgage to a third party (mortgaged floors: 1-10)." From March 20 to June 3 of the same year, Tongde Company, through its employee Chen Tai'an, successively paid RMB 50 million into Property Company's account. Hotel Company used the funds for hotel decoration, equipment purchase and installation, and the completed Jinshan Hotel opened on May 26 of the same year. Shortly thereafter, Tongde Company discovered that the above commitments and guarantees were seriously false, and that there were prominent issues of repeated mortgages and concealment of huge liabilities. To protect its own creditor's rights, Tongde Company exercised its defense of insecurity and filed a lawsuit with the Guilin Intermediate People's Court on August 15, 1997, requesting that the borrowing party be ordered to immediately repay all borrowed funds and bear liability for corresponding losses. After trial, the Guilin Intermediate People's Court rendered a judgment: The defendants, Hotel Company, Property Company, Group Company, and Wang Chengshu, were to repay the plaintiff, Tongde Company, the full amount of RMB 50 million in borrowed funds. The four defendants, dissatisfied, appealed to the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court on the grounds that "the facts found in the original judgment were erroneous and the application of law was improper."

The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court, after trial, held: The loan agreements signed by the appellants, Hotel Company and Group Company, with the appellee, Tongde Company, both pertained to the same loan of RMB 50 million, therefore Hotel Company and Group Company should be regarded as joint borrowers; Hotel Company and the appellant Property Company used their property in Jinshan Hotel as security for the loan, so Hotel Company and Property Company should be regarded as loan mortgagors; the appellant Wang Chengshu, having guaranteed repayment in his personal name, should be regarded as the loan guarantor. The loan contracts between Hotel Company, Group Company, and Tongde Company constituted a loan transaction between enterprises, which violated state financial regulations and should be deemed invalid; both parties bore responsibility for this. The principal contract being invalid, the guaranty contracts were also invalid. Hotel Company and Group Company were to return the loan obtained under the invalid loan contracts to Tongde Company; Property Company and Wang Chengshu, knowing that enterprises were prohibited from lending to each other, nonetheless provided guaranty for the loan contracts, and thus should bear joint and several liability for damages for the debts of Hotel Company and Group Company. Accordingly, the court issued a final judgment on November 27, 1997: Hotel Company and Group Company were to repay RMB 35 million within five days of service of the judgment, and the remaining RMB 15 million was to be fully repaid by December 30, 1997; Property Company was to bear joint and several liability for damages for the debts of Hotel Company and Group Company in this case to the extent of the mortgaged property to Tongde Company; Wang Chengshu was to bear joint and several liability for damages for the debts of Hotel Company and Group Company in this case. After the judgment became binding, the four parties subject to enforcement failed to voluntarily perform the payment obligations specified in the judgment. The applicant for enforcement, Tongde Company, applied to the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court for enforcement. Considering that the parties subject to enforcement and the property to be enforced were all located in Chongqing, in accordance with Article 210, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court, on February 17, 1998, entrusted the Chongqing High People's Court to enforce on its behalf.

The Chongqing High People's Court docketed the case on February 23, 1998, and simultaneously served an enforcement notice on the four parties subject to enforcement, ordering them to perform the obligations specified in Judgment No. 325 (1997) Gui Jing Zhong Zi to the applicant for enforcement, Tongde Company, by March 3 of the same year, but the parties subject to enforcement still failed to do so within the prescribed period. Upon investigation, the court found: The party subject to enforcement, Group Company, is composed of five enterprises: Property Company, Hotel Company, Sanya Huicheng Hotel Company, Sanya Jinshan Holiday Hotel, and Sanya Leshang Entertainment Company, with a registered capital of RMB 60 million, but it had not yet been truly established; the party subject to enforcement, Property Company, is a joint venture approved and established on March 13, 1993, with a registered capital of RMB 30 million, and its main asset is the Chongqing Jinshan Business Building; the party subject to enforcement, Hotel Company, mainly leases floors 2-10 of the annex of the Jinshan Business Building for decoration and hotel operation; the party subject to enforcement, Wang Chengshu, is the legal representative of each of the above companies, and his personal assets are unclear. Meanwhile, other courts across the country had accepted more than 30 lawsuits against Property Company, with litigation targets exceeding RMB 400 million. The only property currently available for enforcement is the Chongqing Jinshan Business Building, the Chongqing Jinshan Hotel, and vehicles and equipment. Apart from the Jinshan Business Building being used by Property Company as collateral for a loan, the other joint construction party, Chongqing Huali Property Company (holding a 26% share), had also mortgaged its share to the Shenzhen Industrial and Commercial Bank for a loan of USD 12 million.

The Chongqing High People's Court commissioned an auditing department to conduct a judicial audit of Jinshan Hotel, and found that the registered capital of Jinshan Hotel had long been withdrawn, and even the RMB 50 million loan from Tongde Company, except for what was used for decoration and opening expenses, had largely been dissipated, leaving no funds available for court enforcement. To uphold the unity of the legal system and the dignity of the law, and to equally protect the lawful rights and interests of both local and out-of-area creditors, the court, based on the principle of separation of ownership and management rights, and with the premise of ensuring that state assets are not lost while also taking into account the protection of the interests of all creditors, proposed a plan: "Compulsory enforcement of Jinshan Hotel, transfer its operational rights to Tongde Company, and use the income to offset the creditor's rights." Under this plan, calculations showed that after paying rent and deducting costs, Jinshan Hotel's annual net cash inflow would be RMB 5.17 million; after the operational rights of Jinshan Hotel were transferred to Tongde Company, the debt would be offset at a fixed rate of RMB 5.17 million per year until fully offset. Both the applicant for enforcement, Tongde Company, and the party subject to enforcement, Hotel Company, agreed to this enforcement plan. Tongde Company also issued a written commitment to the court: after taking over the operational rights of Jinshan Hotel, it would maintain the stability of the hotel staff, maintain the hotel's good operation, and pay the rent for the leased Jinshan Business Building and applicable taxes on time. It also committed that when the court disposed of the Jinshan Business Building, it would have the priority to purchase the corresponding floors of the Jinshan Business Building that involved Jinshan Hotel under the same conditions.

At this point, the case was concluded by enforcement settlement. In accordance with Article 210, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the Chongqing High People's Court has notified the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court of the enforcement situation by letter.
